'''Numbers''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who ran the bar and inn known as the [[Irrational Number]], located at [[Jugsmuk Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. "Numbers" received that name because Bith names were hard to pronounce for non-Bith. Numbers ran an organized establishment with drinking and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]].<ref name="MS" />
